lore.infernalexp.blindsight_tongue_stew: A Soup cooked in a Cooking Pot with Blindsight Tongue, Crimson Fungus and Warped Fungus.
lore.infernalexp.shimmer_sand: A glittering sand found in the Nether's Glowstone Canyons.
lore.infernalexp.glimmer_gravel: A glittering gravel found in the Nether's Glowstone Canyons.
lore.infernalexp.shimmer_stone: A glittering stone found in the Nether's Glowstone Canyons.
lore.infernalexp.dimstone: A dimly glowing stone found in Glowstone Canyons. Crush it to separate Glowstone Dust from Dullrocks.
lore.infernalexp.dullstone: A dull grey stone found in Glowstone Canyons, made of Dullrocks.
lore.infernalexp.dullrocks: Grey rubble crushed out of Dimstone and Dullstone. Combine it with Glowstone Dust to make Dimstone.
lore.infernalexp.glowsilk_cocoon: A glowing cocoon spun by Glowsilk Moths. Break it down into Glowsilk String.
lore.infernalexp.glowsilk_string: Shimmering thread from a Glowsilk Cocoon. Used to make Glowsilk Bows and Tongue Whips.
lore.infernalexp.glowsilk_bow: A bow strung with shimmering Glowsilk.
lore.infernalexp.glowsilk_moth_bottle: A Glowsilk Moth caught in a bottle. It makes a little light source when placed.
lore.infernalexp.luminous_fungus: A glowing fungus found in Glowstone Canyons. Creatures that brush past it are lit up with Luminous.
lore.infernalexp.luminous_fungus_cap: The glowing cap of a Luminous Fungus.
lore.infernalexp.luminous_wart_block: A wart block that grows on huge Luminous Fungi.
lore.infernalexp.crimson_fungus_cap: The cap of a Crimson Fungus, which grows on the side of Crimson Stems.
lore.infernalexp.warped_fungus_cap: The cap of a Warped Fungus, which grows on the side of Warped Stems.
lore.infernalexp.shroomlight_tear: A drip of light that hangs from Shroomlights. Craft them together to make a Shroomlight.
lore.infernalexp.phosphor_shroomlight_te: A drip of blue light that hangs from Phosphor Shroomlights.
lore.infernalexp.dullthorns: A thorny plant from Glowstone Canyons that hurts creatures that touch it.
lore.infernalexp.dullthorns_block: A block of tangled Dullthorns. It hurts creatures that touch it.
lore.infernalexp.basalt_sand: A dark sand found in Basalt Deltas.
lore.infernalexp.volatile_geyser: A vent found in Basalt Deltas that blasts hot gas upwards, launching anything standing above it.
lore.infernalexp.glowcoke: A bright, hot fuel. Used for Glowlight torches, lanterns, and braziers.
lore.infernalexp.glowlight_torch: A torch fuelled by Glowcoke that burns with a bright yellow flame.
lore.infernalexp.glowlight_lantern: A lantern fuelled by Glowcoke that burns with a bright yellow flame.
lore.infernalexp.glowlight_jack_o_lanter: A carved pumpkin lit by a Glowlight Torch.
lore.infernalexp.large_glowlight_jack_o_: A slice of a large carved pumpkin lit by a Glowlight Torch.
lore.infernalexp.voline_bucket: A bucket holding a Voline. Empty it to release it.
lore.infernalexp.strider_bucket: A bucket of lava holding a baby Strider. Empty it to release it.
lore.infernalexp.magma_cube_bucket: A bucket of lava holding a small Magma Cube. Empty it to release it.
lore.infernalexp.blindsight_tongue_whip: A whip made from a Blindsight's tongue. Its long reach lashes enemies from a distance.
lore.infernalexp.blindsight_tongue: The long, sticky tongue of a Blindsight. Cook it into stew, or make it into a whip.
lore.infernalexp.basalt_iron_ore: An ore found in Basalt Deltas that can be mined with a Copper Pickaxe or better to collect Raw Iron.
entity.infernalexp.voline.description: A small hostile mob found in the Nether that gobbles up Magma Cream and grows bigger as it eats.
entity.infernalexp.glowsquito.descriptio: A glowing, blood-sucking insect from Glowstone Canyons.
entity.infernalexp.glowsilk_moth.descrip: A glowing moth that flutters through the Nether's Glowstone Canyons, spinning Glowsilk Cocoons.
entity.infernalexp.blindsight.descriptio: A blind, frog-like hostile mob from Glowstone Canyons that hunts by sound and leaps at its prey.
entity.infernalexp.warpbeetle.descriptio: A beetle found in Warped Forests.
